rule:
The test-period read for a batch sweep -- by a rule written before looking, with no judgement in it.

From ``runs/<fid>/sweep_<tag>.json`` (train / valid only) it picks, mechanically:

* ``v_base`` (the original) and ``k_known`` (the known-family benchmark), always;
* the best variant of each of the 3 best KINDS (structure / leaf / memory / shape / neutral /
  hypothesis ...), ranked by pure-long Sharpe on the user's training period, among variants that
  pass the gates (cov >= 0.95, dist >= 0.5) and whose long leg is positive on BOTH train and valid;
* the two best candidates BUILT ON the known family (overlays, screens, or any hypothesis that contains
  it) -- reported apart, because they are the known family plus a tilt or minus a screen;
* ``k_known_xfrozen``, the generic screen (known family, never the frozen-quote names), as their benchmark.

Only these are scored on the holdout (the user's test period), in the user's convention: half-life fitted on
the user's training period, pure long book net of 15 bp.  The sign of the original and of the benchmarks is the
sign of their rank IC on the user's training period (the user's rule); a picked candidate keeps the sign it was
picked under (``sign_flip`` marks the rare weak signal whose rank IC changes sign once valid is added).  The read
is ledgered.

v_base.expr: abs_(cs_demean(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 5))))

k_known_xfrozen.why: 已知族 + 剔除近 15 日冻结盘口最重的 20%(通用筛子基准)

h_sum_rv_amtchg.why: 两种粗糙度(价与量)的折叠秩相加:如果它们测的是同一件事,相加应该只降噪;如果净超额明显上去,说明是两个独立的维度

fld_Volume_Amt.expr: abs_(cs_demean(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Amt, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 5))))
fld_Volume_Amt.why: 字段 Volume → Amt(同为 flow):这条 alpha 依不依赖这个字段的身份

seg_lowliq_m.expr: cs_first_low40(neg(abs_(cs_demean(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 5))))), cross_mean(day_sum(Amt), 30))
seg_lowliq_m.why: 只在成交额最低 40% 的股票里按本因子选

h3_scr_kx_xhi.why: 两道筛子串联。scr_xhi_p(k_known 剔掉本因子 |K| 最高 20%)2.60 对 k_known 2.22 = +0.38(>噪声);xfrozen 那道筛子单独值 +0.93。两道剔的票几乎不重叠(本因子高 |K| 是高日内波动,xfrozen 是冻结盘口,ρ 仅 0.22)。若 +0.38 与 +0.93 可加,串联版该到 3.4~3.5;若串联后不动,本因子的筛子作用只是 xfrozen 的一个代理 —— 这是「只能当筛子」这条定论的最终检验,预期 sg = +1

h3_ov_kx_roll5.why: s2 全表 149 条里没有任何一条叠在真门槛 k_known_xfrozen(+18.5%,Lshp 3.15)上 —— overlay 与 screen 全部只叠在 k_known(2.22)上,所以「本因子越不过 3.15」这个结论从没被正面测过。两腿都写成「高 = 做多」(KX 自带 neg,本因子腿补 neg),预期 sg = +1(s2 工具问题 2)。判据:ut > 3.45
